summary: Design a transparent, ethical study with testable hypotheses and defensible methods.
intents: how many users do we need for this A/B test
design an experiment to test the new onboarding
set up a randomized study with a control group
what is the minimum detectable effect for our traffic
prerequisites: the research question and field context
available equipment/data, relevant standards, and appropriate supervision for regulated work
verify: Primary metric, hypothesis and stopping rule are fixed before data collection
Sample size comes from a stated power calculation
Ethics, consent and exclusion criteria are documented
